welcome.heading: Profile
paragraphs: An accomplished academic and researcher specialising in Informatics, with expertise in Information Security, Digital Forensics, and Artificial Intelligence. Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) graduate from Universiti Teknikal Malaysia (UTeM) in 2025.
Active publisher in reputable international journals with an H-Index of 8 and engaged in cross-national research collaborations.

recruitment.heading: Current Focus
recruitment.body: Professional work spans lecturing, editorial leadership, academic publishing, IT consulting, and research collaboration in digital forensics, cybersecurity, cryptography, and AI.
